course_points.n: Rechtsaf and take B 42 toward Loreley
Houd links aan naar Untere Gartenstraße

points_of_interest.name: Docking Oberwesel
points_of_interest.description: Start anchor for the replacement route leg in Oberwesel. Schedule: Start from the ship/docking point; good place to brief the Rhine Gorge day.

points_of_interest.name: Burg Rheinfels / St Goar
points_of_interest.description: Castle viewpoint above St Goar; optional short climb/detour from the river route. Schedule: Optional photo/history stop if time allows; otherwise view from the river level.

points_of_interest.name: Boppard Rhine Promenade
points_of_interest.description: Practical cafe/rest area on the Rhine promenade in Boppard. Schedule: Suggested coffee or lunch pause before continuing toward Lahnstein.

points_of_interest.name: Marksburg View
points_of_interest.description: Marksburg castle marker; useful as a visible Rhine landmark across/near the river. Schedule: Mention as scenic castle view; treat as optional unless crossing/detour is planned.

points_of_interest.name: Docking Niederlahnstein
points_of_interest.description: Finish anchor for the Oberwesel to Niederlahnstein leg. Schedule: End-of-day ship/docking point.
